spec: Implement a module that takes two 1-bit inputs a and b and produces three outputs: y_and = a AND b, y_or = a OR b, y_xor = a XOR b.
module_head: module top_module(input a, input b, output y_and, output y_or, output y_xor);

spec: Implement an 8-bit 2-to-1 multiplexer. When sel is 0 the output y equals a, when sel is 1 y equals b.
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input sel, output [7:0] y);

spec: Implement a 4-to-1 multiplexer with 4-bit data inputs d0, d1, d2, d3, a 2-bit select input sel and a 4-bit output y. y = d0 when sel=0, d1 when sel=1, d2 when sel=2, d3 when sel=3.
module_head: module top_module(input [3:0] d0, input [3:0] d1, input [3:0] d2, input [3:0] d3, input [1:0] sel, output [3:0] y);

spec: Implement a 3-to-8 decoder with enable. Input in is 3 bits, en is 1 bit, output out is 8 bits. When en is 1, exactly the bit out[in] is 1 and the others are 0. When en is 0, out is all zeros.
module_head: module top_module(input [2:0] in, input en, output [7:0] out);

spec: Implement a 4-bit priority encoder. Input in is 4 bits. Output pos (2 bits) is the index of the highest set bit of in, and valid is 1 when any bit of in is set. When in is 0, pos is 0 and valid is 0.
module_head: module top_module(input [3:0] in, output reg [1:0] pos, output valid);

spec: Implement an 8-bit adder with carry in. Inputs a and b are 8 bits, cin is 1 bit. Output sum is 8 bits and cout is the carry out.
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input cin, output [7:0] sum, output cout);

spec: Implement an 8-bit unsigned comparator. Inputs a and b are 8 bits. Outputs: gt is 1 when a > b, eq is 1 when a == b, lt is 1 when a < b.
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output gt, output eq, output lt);

spec: Implement a population count circuit. Input in is 8 bits. Output count is 4 bits and equals the number of 1 bits in in.
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] in, output [3:0] count);

spec: Implement an even parity generator. Input data is 8 bits. Output parity is 1 when data contains an odd number of 1s, so that data together with parity has an even number of 1s.
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] data, output parity);

spec: Implement a 4-bit binary to Gray code converter. Input bin is 4 bits, output gray is 4 bits, where gray = bin XOR (bin shifted right by 1).
module_head: module top_module(input [3:0] bin, output [3:0] gray);

spec: Implement an 8-bit left rotator. Input data is 8 bits and amt is 3 bits. Output out is data rotated left by amt positions (bits shifted out of the MSB come back in at the LSB).
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] data, input [2:0] amt, output [7:0] out);

spec: Implement a 4-bit ALU. Inputs a and b are 4 bits, op is 2 bits. Output y is 4 bits: op=0: a + b (ignore carry), op=1: a - b, op=2: a & b, op=3: a | b.
module_head: module top_module(input [3:0] a, input [3:0] b, input [1:0] op, output reg [3:0] y);

spec: Implement a circuit that outputs the absolute value of an 8-bit two's complement number. Input x is 8 bits (signed), output y is 8 bits. For x = -128 the output is 8'h80.
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] x, output [7:0] y);

spec: Implement a circuit that outputs the maximum of three 8-bit unsigned inputs a, b and c on the 8-bit output m.
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input [7:0] c, output [7:0] m);

spec: Implement an 8-bit register with an active-low asynchronous reset. Inputs: clk, rst_n, d (8 bits). Output q (8 bits). On the rising edge of clk, q takes d. When rst_n is 0, q is cleared to 0 immediately.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input rst_n, input [7:0] d, output reg [7:0] q);

spec: Implement a 4-bit up counter with synchronous active-high reset and enable. Inputs: clk, reset, en. Output q (4 bits). On each rising edge of clk: if reset is 1, q becomes 0; otherwise if en is 1, q increments by 1 (wrapping from 15 to 0).
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, input en, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Implement an 8-bit serial-in parallel-out shift register with synchronous active-high reset. Inputs: clk, reset, din (1 bit). Output q (8 bits). On each rising clock edge, if reset is 1 then q becomes 0, otherwise q shifts left by one and din enters at q[0].
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, input din, output reg [7:0] q);

spec: Implement a rising edge detector. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high), sig. Output pulse is a registered 1-cycle pulse: on each rising clock edge, pulse becomes 1 if sig is 1 now and sig was 0 at the previous clock edge, otherwise 0. Reset clears all state to 0.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, input sig, output reg pulse);

spec: Implement a Moore FSM that detects the overlapping bit sequence 1-0-1 on input x. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high), x. Output z is 1 for one cycle after the last 1 of the sequence 101 has been received (z depends only on the state). Overlapping is allowed, so 10101 produces two detections.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, input x, output z);

spec: Implement a 4-bit Fibonacci LFSR. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high). Output q (4 bits). On reset q becomes 4'b0001. Otherwise on each rising clock edge q shifts left by one and the new q[0] is q[3] XOR q[2].
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Implement an 8-bit accumulator. Inputs: clk, rst_n (asynchronous, active low), load, in (8 bits). Output acc (8 bits). When rst_n is 0, acc is 0. On each rising clock edge, if load is 1 then acc becomes in, otherwise acc becomes acc + in (wrapping).
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input rst_n, input load, input [7:0] in, output reg [7:0] acc);

spec: Implement a divide-by-4 clock enable generator. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high). Output tick is 1 for one cycle out of every 4 cycles. After reset, an internal 2-bit counter is 0 and tick is 1 when the counter equals 3. The counter increments every cycle.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, output tick);

spec: Implement an 8-to-1 multiplexer. Input in is 8 bits, sel is 3 bits, output y is 1 bit and equals in[sel].
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] in, input [2:0] sel, output y);

spec: Implement an 8-bit subtractor. Inputs a and b are 8 bits. Output diff is 8 bits and equals a - b (wrapping), and output borrow is 1 when a < b (unsigned).
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output [7:0] diff, output borrow);

spec: Implement a circuit with an 8-bit input in and a 1-bit output ok. ok is 1 when exactly one bit of in is 1.
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] in, output ok);

spec: Implement a circuit that reverses the bit order of an 8-bit input in: out[0] = in[7], out[1] = in[6], ..., out[7] = in[0].
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] in, output [7:0] out);

spec: Implement an 8-bit unsigned saturating adder. Inputs a and b are 8 bits. Output s is a + b, but if the true sum is greater than 255 then s is 255.
module_head: module top_module(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output [7:0] s);

spec: Implement a decade counter. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high). Output q (4 bits) counts 0, 1, ..., 9, 0, ... on each rising clock edge. Reset sets q to 0.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Implement a 4-bit down counter with load. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high), load, d (4 bits). Output q (4 bits). On each rising clock edge: if reset, q becomes 0; else if load, q becomes d; else q decrements by 1 (wrapping from 0 to 15).
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, input load, input [3:0] d, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Implement a T flip-flop. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high), t. Output q. On each rising clock edge, if reset is 1 then q becomes 0, else if t is 1 then q toggles.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, input t, output reg q);

spec: Implement a 4-bit register with asynchronous active-high reset and enable. Inputs: clk, areset, en, d (4 bits). Output q (4 bits). When areset is 1, q is 0 immediately. Otherwise on the rising edge of clk, if en is 1 then q takes d.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input areset, input en, input [3:0] d, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Implement a Moore FSM that outputs z = 1 when the input x has been 1 on the last two rising clock edges. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high), x. Output z.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, input x, output z);

spec: Implement a 4-bit ring counter. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high). Output q (4 bits). Reset sets q to 4'b0001. On each rising clock edge q rotates left by one: 0001, 0010, 0100, 1000, 0001, ...
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Implement a circuit that outputs the minimum of two 8-bit signed (two's complement) inputs a and b on the 8-bit output m.
module_head: module top_module(input signed [7:0] a, input signed [7:0] b, output signed [7:0] m);

spec: Implement a 4-bit 2-to-1 multiplexer. When s is 1 the output out equals x, otherwise out equals y.
module_head: module top_module(input [3:0] x, input [3:0] y, input s, output [3:0] out);

spec: Implement a module with two 4-bit inputs a and b and a 4-bit output y where y is the bitwise XNOR of a and b.
module_head: module top_module(input [3:0] a, input [3:0] b, output [3:0] y);

spec: Implement a circuit with a 16-bit input in and a 1-bit output z. z is 1 when all bits of in are 0.
module_head: module top_module(input [15:0] in, output z);

spec: Implement a 4-bit incrementer. Input a is 4 bits, output y is 4 bits and equals a + 1 (wrapping), and output c is 1 when a is 15.
module_head: module top_module(input [3:0] a, output [3:0] y, output c);

spec: Implement a 4-bit D register with synchronous active-high reset. Inputs: clk, reset, d (4 bits). Output q (4 bits). On each rising clock edge, q becomes 0 if reset is 1, otherwise q takes d.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, input [3:0] d, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Implement a 3-bit up counter. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high). Output q (3 bits). Reset sets q to 0, otherwise q increments on each rising clock edge (wrapping from 7 to 0).
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, output reg [2:0] q);

spec: Implement a 4-bit shift register that shifts right. Inputs: clk, reset (synchronous, active high), in. Output q (4 bits). On each rising clock edge, if reset then q becomes 0, otherwise q shifts right by one and in enters at q[3].
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, input in, output reg [3:0] q);

spec: Implement a circuit with inputs clk and reset (synchronous, active high) and output q. Reset sets q to 0. Otherwise q inverts on every rising clock edge.
module_head: module top_module(input clk, input reset, output reg q);
